items.raw_excerpt: RMIT Saigon South has become the first foreign university branch campus licensed in Vietnam, clearing the way for the school to expand its campus and course offerings.

items.raw_excerpt: British politics has a long-cherished reputation for attracting the weird and wonderful. items.raw_excerpt: Members of a British family who for months avoided paying French motorway tolls by simply lifting the barrier at toll booths have been stopped in eastern France, police have said.
items.summary_en: A British family avoided paying French motorway tolls for months by lifting the barrier at toll booths. Police stopped them in eastern France. The family now faces a fine.

items.raw_excerpt: The biggest solar eclipse over the Netherlands in 27 years will take place on Wednesday evening, when around 90% of the sun will disappear behind the moon. The eclipse begins at about 7.15pm and reaches its peak around 8.10pm, when the moon appears to take its largest bite out of the sun. The two then set together roughly an hour later. Because the sun will already be low in the sky by then, anyone hoping to watch will need a...
items.summary_en: The biggest solar eclipse in the Netherlands in 27 years takes place on Wednesday evening. About 90% of the sun will disappear behind the moon. It starts at about 7.15pm and peaks around 8.10pm, just before the sun sets.
items.summary_ko: 27년 만에 가장 큰 일식이 수요일 저녁 네덜란드에서 일어난다. 달이 태양의 약 90%를 가릴 예정이다. 오후 7시 15분경 시작해 오후 8시 10분경 최고조에 달한다.
items.title_en: Biggest solar eclipse in 27 years will darken Dutch skies tonight

items.raw_excerpt: Some schools want to further tighten the ban on mobile phones, while a government initiative means primary schools now have a legal obligation to promote a physically active lifestyle.
items.summary_en: Finnish primary schools now must promote a physically active lifestyle by law. Some schools want to tighten their ban on mobile phones. The goal is more moving and less screen time for children.

items.title_en: More moving and less screens - Finland's school year starts with active plans for kids
items.title_ko: 더 많이 움직이고 화면은 덜 보고 - 핀란드 학교 새 학년을 활동 계획으로 시작

items.summary_en: A British gym chain ranked Fimmvorduhals as the world's 10th toughest bucket-list hike. The chain seems eager to share the ranking. The hike is in Iceland.

items.raw_excerpt: The long-lost wreck of Royal Navy warship HMS Tiger was discovered off the Isle of Wight.
items.summary_en: Divers found the wreck of Royal Navy warship HMS Tiger near the Isle of Wight. The ship sank 118 years ago and was lost for a long time. The discovery ends a long search for the warship.

items.raw_excerpt: Poles and electricity boxes were installed in 2023 in Nyamankulu near Cofimvaba, but Eskom and Intsika Yethu Municipality say there are outstanding issues
items.summary_en: Electricity poles and boxes were installed in 2023 in Nyamankulu, a village near Cofimvaba in the Eastern Cape. But there is still no power supply. Eskom and the local municipality say outstanding issues remain, so villagers are still waiting after 30 years.
items.summary_ko: 남아프리카공화국 동부 케이프주 코핌바바 근처 니아만쿨루 마을에는 2023년 전봇대와 전기 상자가 설치되었습니다. 하지만 아직도 전력이 공급되지 않습니다. 에스콤과 지역 지자체는 해결되지 않은 문제가 남아 있다고 말하며, 주민들은 30년이 지나도록 전기를 기다리고 있습니다.

items.summary_en: People in Darwin, Australia are worried about new AI data centres. They say the centres use too much water and make too much noise. Residents want a pause until the plans are reviewed.

items.title_en: Residents in Darwin ask for a stop to AI data centres
